thread:
alex_cheung: kicking off il1 GPU pool bring-up, hit a blocker during KMS integration. several nodes fail to finish bootstrap because CSI can't decrypt PVs. rolling back AMI made kubelet fail on encrypted mounts. need eyes, tagging oncall.

maria_gonzalez: seeing 12/48 nodes NotReady, pods CrashLoopBackOff for stateful workloads, monitoring shows repeated 403 from KMS for decrypt requests. autoscaler spun up CPU fallback nodes, cost metric spiking. Link to grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/il1/gpu-pool

jin_park: can you paste the csi/kubelet error? also which key alias are we using for il1?

alex_cheung: paste from one failed node:

```
I0318 12:34:56.789 kubelet: MountVolume.SetUp failed for volume pvc-0a1b: rpc error: code=PermissionDenied desc=failed to decrypt: AccessDeniedException: Access denied
csi-provisioner: attach/detach shows error: encrypt/decrypt failed
```

tyler_harper: probable cause: the node role doesn't have kms:Decrypt permission in key policy or we rotated alias during AMI bake. check the KMS key policy and node instance profile. run: `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/il1-cluster-key` and `aws iam get-role --role-name node-role-il1`

lina_ops: we did change the alias during last bake to use new key material (KMS rotate), but forgot to update key policy to include the node instance role ARN. that explains AccessDenied. re-adding role to policy should fix new nodes, but existing encrypted EBS volumes that were created with previous key alias may still fail until reattached and re-encrypted.

maria_gonzalez: re-encrypting all PVs is multi-day. currently fallback CPU nodes are provisioning unencrypted volumes which pushed hourly cost estimate +$4.2k. sre-bot posted cost alert.

sre-bot: automated alert: estimated incremental infra cost for il1 incident: $4,200/day if fallback remains for >12 hours. Incident severity: P2. See cost dashboard.

jin_park: quick mitigation options:
- update KMS key policy to allow node-role-il1 and restart kubelet on affected nodes (should allow decrypt)
- provision a small canary of 3 nodes with corrected policy and test mounts before rolling cluster-wide
- if time-critical, attach snapshots to a helper instance, decrypt and create new unencrypted snapshots, restore PVs (data-migration heavy)

alex_cheung: we attempted a rollback to previous AMI, but that AMI references the old alias which no longer exists; nodes booted then kubelet failed during mount path and many pods stuck Terminating when we tried `kubectl drain`. output:

```
kubectl drain node-il1-003 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
Warning: ignoring DaemonSet-managed Pods: kube-proxy
error: failed to evict pod elasticsearch-0, it is being deleted for >5m
```

tyler_harper: rolling back AMI without restoring KMS alias will leave node identity out of sync. rollbacks must include KMS alias mapping when we change key material. add to runbook: when baking AMI with encrypted EBS, do not rotate alias without updating cluster key policy and regenerating node IAM trust if needed.

lina_ops: agreed. immediate next steps I propose:
1) stop rollout (ACTION: alex)
2) re-add node-role-il1 principal to kms key policy (ACTION: jin)
3) bring up 3 canary nodes with corrected policy, validate PV mounts and start stateful sets (ACTION: jin + lina)
4) if canary OK, proceed rolling replace nodes; if not OK, escalate to data-migration plan (ACTION: ops lead)
5) update provisioning runbook with alias-change checklist and cost contingency (ACTION: alex + lina)

alex_cheung: stopping rollout now, marking this thread for handoff. I'm tagging oncall: @jin_park and @lina_ops — please take ownership for the next 2 hours and run the canary test. I'll open a postmortem ticket after initial mitigation. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/il1-provisioning (add KMS alias checklist)

jin_park: taking it. starting key policy update now, will post results.

lina_ops: standby to validate canary once jin confirms. I'll draft the runbook edits and include rollback/rollback-without-kms steps and cost thresholds.

alex_cheung: thanks all — I'll update this thread with any cross-team comms. :thumbsup:
